system_texts: The teletext feature is outmoded and should not be considered in the new project design.
The remote control should be used only for the TV.
The group proposed setting a target to achieve at least 50 million Euro in revenue, and noted that there is currently no explicit financial objective or consensus on the revenue target.
The management said they want something new and do not want to continue with certain existing facilities.
gold_texts: Final feature selection was deferred. The industrial designer suggested starting with all features, the user interface designer objected to wasted design effort, and further discussion was left until after the meeting.
A slim shape, simple interface, locator, voice recognition and durable casing were favored design ideas, with feasibility, cost and final feature selection still unresolved.
